summary: Fixed three bugs in src/lib.rs so the closed-integer-interval semantics match the tests: (1) Interval::len (src/lib.rs:18-20) returned end-start, off by one for closed intervals — now end-start+1; (2) Interval::contains (src/lib.rs:22-24) used x < end, excluding the right endpoint — now x <= end; (3) merge (src/lib.rs:34,38) sorted by end instead of start and merged only on overlap, not adjacency — now sorts by start and merges when it.start <= last.end + 1. Verified: `cargo test --offline --quiet` exits 0, all 5 tests pass. No test files were modified.
